questions.subject: english
questions.question: We are able to get a variety of enjoyment due to our ..........
questions.explanation: Manushya apni buddhimatta aur intelligence ke kaaran vibhinn prakaar ke anand prapt karne mein saksham hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: We are more friendly ..........
questions.explanation: Hum apne samooh ya parivar (within the herd) ke bheetar adhik mitravat aur sahayogi hote hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: After language, the second most important thing which helped mankind was ..........
questions.explanation: Bhasha ke baad aag (fire) ki khoj manav vikas ka doosra sabse bada kadam sidhh hui.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The taming of domestic animals made human life ..........
questions.explanation: Pashuon ko paaltoo banane se manav jeevan pehle se kahin adhik aasan aur sukhad (pleasanter) ban gaya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Ideas That Have Helped Mankind' has been written by ..........
questions.explanation: Is vicharotpadak nibandh ke lekhak prasiddh British darshanik Bertrand Russell hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The two broad categories of ideas that contributed to mankind were knowledge and technique, and ..........
questions.explanation: Russell ne sahayak vicharon ko do hisson mein baanta hai: gyan-takneek aur naitik-rajneetik (moral and politics).

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Bertrand Russell was awarded the Nobel Prize for ..........
questions.explanation: Bertrand Russell ko unki sahityik rachnaon ke liye saahitya (literature) ka Nobel Prize mila tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The most indubitable respect in which ideas have helped mankind is ..........
questions.explanation: Sabse nishchit roop se vicharon ne manav sankhya (numbers) ko badhane aur astitva bachane mein sahayata ki.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Survival for early Homo sapiens primarily was ..........
questions.explanation: Shuruati daur mein vishal aur jangali janwaron ke beech jeevit rehna ek gambhir samasya (a problem) thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Birds die of hunger in large numbers ..........
questions.explanation: Kadi sardi (winter) ke mausam mein bhojan ki kami se pakshi badi sankhya mein mar jaate hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: During summer, birds ..........
questions.explanation: Garmiyan aane par pakshi pichhli sardi ki us vipatti (catastrophe) ko poori tarah bhool jaate hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Every human death by starvation is preceded by a long period of ..........
questions.explanation: Bhookh se hone wali manav mrityu se pehle lamba samay chinta aur darr (anxiety) ka hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Animals do NOT get pleasure from ..........
questions.explanation: Pashuon ko sangeet, football ya vigyan kisi se bhi manvik anand nahi milta.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... would not help the corn to grow unless he was allowed to feast on the blood of children.
questions.explanation: Pracheen andhavishwas ke mutabiq devta Moloch bachhon ke balidan ke bina fasal nahi ugne deta tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Bertrand Russell was a philosopher and a ..........
questions.explanation: Bertrand Russell ek mahan darshanik ke sath-sath itihaskar (historian) aur ganitagya bhi the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The invention of .......... was more important than the domestication of animals.
questions.explanation: Krishi (agriculture) ka aavishkar pashupalan se bhi kahin adhik moolbhut aur mahatvapurna kadam tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Civilization has taught us ..........

options.C: to be more friendly towards others

questions.explanation: Sabhyata ne hamein apne samooh mein ek-doosre ke prati adhik mitravat banna sikhaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... was a brilliant commentator on a large variety of topics.
questions.explanation: Bertrand Russell anek vishayon par nishpaksh aur gahri tippani karne wale lekhak the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which type of prose piece is 'Ideas That Have Helped Mankind'?
questions.explanation: 'Ideas That Have Helped Mankind' sahityik vidha ke roop mein ek nibandh (essay) hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In .......... the last step in the development of writing was never taken.
questions.explanation: China mein chitra-lipi ke baad dhwani-aadharit varna-lipi ka aakhiri kadam nahi uthaya gaya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who offered penetrating comments on diverse topics like Marx, Buddha, and Christ?
questions.explanation: Bertrand Russell ne Marx, Buddha aur Christ jaise vyaktitvaon par nishpaksh vichar diye hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Bertrand Russell belonged to which country?
questions.explanation: Bertrand Russell Britain (United Kingdom) ke nivasi the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Civilization fundamentally taught humans ..........
questions.explanation: Sabhyata ne manushya ko manviya sanskar aur aachar-vyavahar (to be human) sikhaye.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Bertrand Russell awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature?
questions.explanation: Bertrand Russell ko saal 1950 mein Nobel Prize se sammanit kiya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who wrote the famous philosophical piece 'Why I Am Not a Christian'?
questions.explanation: 'Why I Am Not a Christian' Bertrand Russell ki prasiddh pustak hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The utilization of .......... proved to be a major milestone in human progress.
questions.explanation: Aag ka sadupyog manav sabhyata ki pragati mein meel ka patthar sidhh hua.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Roads to Freedom' was authored by ..........
questions.explanation: 'Roads to Freedom' Bertrand Russell dwara likhi gayi pustak hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The most important and difficult steps in human development were taken before the dawn of ..........
questions.explanation: Sabse kathin aur moolbhoot kadam likhit itihas ke shuru hone (dawn of history) se pehle uthaye gaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... skills play a more important role in human life than congenital ones.
questions.explanation: Manushya ke jeevan mein seekhe gaye kaushal (acquired skills) janmjat kshamtaon se zyada asardari hote hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Bertrand Russell born?
questions.explanation: Bertrand Russell ka janam saal 1872 mein Wales, United Kingdom mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year did Bertrand Russell pass away?
questions.explanation: Bertrand Russell ka nidhan 97 varsh ki aayu mein saal 1970 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which monumental philosophical survey was written by Bertrand Russell in 1945?
questions.explanation: 'A History of Western Philosophy' Russell ki vishva-vikhyat pustak hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the unique intellectual power of planning ahead called in human development?
questions.explanation: Aage ki yojana banane aur khatron ko pehle se bhaampne ki kshamta ko door-darshita (foresight) kehte hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What disadvantage does human foresight bring along with safety?

options.B: Continuous worry, anxiety, and dread of the future

questions.explanation: Bhavishya ke baare mein sochne ki kshamta manushya ke jeevan mein nirantar chinta aur tanav (anxiety) laati hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What vital faculty enabled early humans to pass down inventions and tools to their children?
questions.explanation: Bhasha (language) ke vikas ne gyan aur aavishkaron ko peedhi-dar-peedhi aage badhane mein madad ki.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How do civilized human beings still tend to behave towards those outside their herd?
questions.explanation: Samooh ke bahar ke logon ke prati manav vyavahar aksar kathor, aakramak aur hinsa-bhara hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which book on social and domestic life was written by Bertrand Russell in 1929?
questions.explanation: 'Marriage and Morals' Russell dwara likhi gayi ek prabhavshali pustak hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'indubitable' as used in the essay?
questions.explanation: 'Indubitable' ka arth nisandeh ya nishchit (unquestionable) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What accidentally originated from the regular use of fire by early humans?
questions.explanation: Aag ke prayog se anjaane mein bhojan pakaane (cooking) ki kala ka aavishkar hua.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which of the following works was NOT written by Bertrand Russell?
questions.explanation: 'The Waste Land' T. S. Eliot ki rachna hai, Bertrand Russell ki nahi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was Russell's philosophical stance regarding war and violence?
questions.explanation: Russell shantivadi (pacifist) the aur taksangat vicharon ke prabal samarthak the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Why did early humans need an increase in population numbers?

options.B: To survive against harsh elements and terrifying wild beasts
options.C: To create armies for foreign invasions

questions.explanation: Prakriti aur khatarnak janwaron se suraksha ke liye manav sankhya ka badhna atyant zaroori tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the antonym of the word 'congenital'?
questions.explanation: 'Congenital' (janmjat) ka vipritarthak shabd 'Acquired' (arjit kiya gaya) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The invention of agriculture encouraged mankind to give up nomadic life and ..........
questions.explanation: Kheti ne manushya ko bhatakna chhudakar sthayi roop se basne aur samaj banane ke liye prerit kiya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the word 'catastrophe' mean in the essay?

options.B: A sudden disaster or widespread calamity

questions.explanation: 'Catastrophe' ka arth achanak aayi bhayanak aapatda ya vinash (disaster) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Russell's prose style is universally admired for being clear, lucid, and ..........
questions.explanation: Russell ki lekhan-shaili spasht, prabhavshali (forceful) aur tarkik mani jaati hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Russell was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in recognition of his championship of ..........

options.B: humanitarian ideals and freedom of thought

questions.explanation: Unhin manavtawadi aadarsho aur vicharon ki aazadi ke samarthan ke liye Nobel samman diya gaya.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What crucial skill developed after pictographic communication to preserve civilization's history?
questions.explanation: Lekhan kala (writing) ne gyan ko sanchit karne aur itihas ko aage badhane mein sarvochha bhoomika nibhayi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the central theme of 'Ideas That Have Helped Mankind'?

options.A: Civilization developed through a gradual evolution of practical inventions and moral values
options.B: War is necessary for human survival
options.C: Animals are intellectually superior to men
options.D: Modern machines have completely destroyed mankind

questions.explanation: Nibandh ka mool vishay yahi hai ki sabhyata gyan, aavishkar aur naitikta ke kramik vikas se bani hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What distinct emotional problem plagues human beings that animals do not suffer from?

options.B: Boredom and dread of imaginary future misfortunes

questions.explanation: Manushya aane wale samay ki kalpanik vipattiyon aur uktahat (boredom) se peedit rehta hai, jo janwaron mein nahi hoti.
